reviewed_by: Claude review of published model context windows
reason: resolve_context_limits now falls back to a generated table of published context/output limits (src/nebula/v3/known_model_limits.py, built by scripts/refresh_known_model_limits.py) when a non-local provider has no exact catalog descriptor, reporting capacity source known_model. Catalog descriptors, configured caps and the unverified-OpenRouter 8k ceiling take precedence as before. The UI maps the new source to a 'published model limits' label. Selected tests cover limit resolution and model-id folding in test_context.py, chat compaction that consumes these limits in test_chat.py, the context-status client mapping in client.test.ts, and the assistant Playwright area.
exclusions: No full suites. Orchestration uses the same resolve_context_limits path with local fixture profiles, which the table intentionally skips; test_orchestration.py has two compaction failures that already reproduce on main. No LAN-origin check: no origin, cookie or socket behavior changed.
